company.name: WorkFlowy
company.shortDescription: WorkFlowy is a web-based app to organize activities such as daily work, team projects, research papers, journals and wedding planning.
company.description: WorkFlowy is a tool for organizing your brain. It provides a powerful interface for hierarchical lists. People use it as a replacement for text editors and spreadsheets as organizational tools. They leave it open all day and put whatever passes through their brain in it - project plans, to-do's, meeting notes, brainstorms, etc..

productsAndServices.description: A web-based app that organizes notes, tasks, projects, and knowledge in a single, infinitely nested outline structure.
productsAndServices.name: Workflowy Digital Notebook

productsAndServices.description: A feature that converts lists into nested kanban-style boards for visual task and project management.

productsAndServices.description: A feature that creates live, automatically updating copies of any item within Workflowy.

productsAndServices.description: Optional AI tools integrated with third-party language models to generate, edit, summarize, and improve content within Workflowy documents.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Powered Features

productsAndServices.description: Allows users to share any item or document with others, including those without Workflowy accounts, with configurable permissions.
productsAndServices.name: Sharing and Collaboration

productsAndServices.description: A feature to create reusable document outlines by marking items as templates for quick duplication.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,404,539 to $5,703,392, a 1.68x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 85 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
